token.label: Notion token
token.description: A Notion personal access token, or an internal connection's API token shared with your list. Anyone who can open this page can read it: protect the bar's HTTP API with a password.

list.label: Start page (optional)
list.description: Leave empty to start from your top-level pages. Or paste a link to a page or database to start there: in Notion, ... menu > Copy link.

scope.label: Show
scope.description: Which rows a database shows, when it has a date. A page always shows every unchecked to-do.
